landing.title: CofferNode
landing.heroDescription: Trade vaults peer-to-peer with smart contract escrow. Non-custodial, secure, and permissionless.

howItWorksSection.title: How it works
howItWorksSection.subtitle: From contact to trade in four straightforward steps.
howItWorksSection.step1Description: Create your trusted network and discover offers from friends, and friends of friends.
howItWorksSection.step2Description: Vexl works as a private marketplace. Browse or add offers and choose who you want to connect with.
howItWorksSection.step3Description: Send or receive request based on an offer. Chat anonymously until you decide to reveal your identity.
howItWorksSection.step4Description: Agree on the details, meet in person, and exchange privately. Vexl never handles your money or tracks your purchases.

featuresSection.title: Built for Trustless Trading
featuresSection.subtitle: Smart contract escrow, zero platform fees, and full control over your assets.

nonCustodial.title: You hold your keys
nonCustodial.description: Funds are locked in smart contracts, not our servers. Full control over your assets.

p2p.title: No Middleman
p2p.description: Direct trades. No centralized entity can freeze you.

cost.title: Low Fees
cost.description: Zero platform fees. Only standard network gas.

code.title: Smart Contract Based
code.description: Fully automated escrow logic. Open-source, auditable, and trustless by design.

faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions we get the most.
faqSection.q1Answer: Yes. Funds are locked in smart contract escrow, released only when both parties confirm. We never hold your crypto.
faqSection.q2Answer: Zero platform fees. You only pay standard network gas for on-chain transactions.
faqSection.q3Answer: Yes. You always control your private keys. Funds move only when you sign transactions.
faqSection.q4Title: Do I need to trust the other person?
faqSection.q4Answer: No. The crypto is locked in a smart contract that neither the buyer nor the seller can touch alone. Only after the buyer confirms, or after a dispute is resolved by the arbitrator, are the funds released.
faqSection.q5Answer: Either party can open a dispute. The platform's arbitrator will review the evidence and decide whether the funds go to the seller or back to the buyer. The arbitrator's decision is final.
faqSection.q6Answer: The platform supports any ERC-20 token (like USDC, DAI, USDT) that the seller chooses to accept. The contract handles the token securely.
